notablePrerequisites:
Undercover Operative on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Undercover Operative do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Undercover Operative.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Undercover Operative.
Activate Undercover Operative by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Undercover Operative ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
